description: Asset bubble reversal triggers collateral stress forced selling and broader financial fragility.
Debt service and refinancing stress crowd out public investment and social protection.
Nonbank leverage redemptions private credit opacity and common asset holdings transmit stress.
Deposits and confidence move quickly through digital channels social media and automated markets.
Climate losses disrupt insurance property markets municipal finance and bank collateral.
Weak standards and speculative products misallocate transition capital and hide climate exposure.
Household balance sheets weaken under debt service housing costs medical costs and income insecurity.
Strong regulation public capacity household protection and climate risk governance reduce systemic stress.
